'''Francis Lalumiere''' was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] (Gold 28, earlier Red 23) who wrote SWCCG articles for Decipher's website and ''Scrye''.<ref name="decsq-prof" /><ref name="sm-fan" /> He also wrote Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] Design Diary.<ref name="jkpersonae" />

He joined the squadron in 1996 in Montreal and traveled to Tunisia as part of the 1996 World Championships grand prize. He wrote articles for Decipher's website and ''Scrye'', and from fall 1998 wrote for Lucasfilm's website.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Lalumiere wrote Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] Design Diary (October 2000 – April 2001) and is credited on the game's team.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
